builds.name: Unstoppable Force ceiling
builds.summary: Find a high-number candidate for Unstoppable Force in the specified finite setup; compare the competing stat package.
builds.goal: Find a high-number candidate for Unstoppable Force in the specified finite setup; compare the competing stat package.
builds.hypothesis: R3 is400+0.9 AP magic. Armor scales E/W, not R; AP/MR penetration directly support impact. Deathcap amplifies AP; Shadowflame supplies15 flat magic penetration/conditional lowHP magic-true amplification; Void supplies40% MR penetration; Banshee/Zhonya supply105 AP each; Riftmaker supplies HP-to-AP and verified8% combat ramp.

ceiling.finiteState: Level18; max rank selected ability; minute30; target3000 maxHP (1500 bonusHP),100 armor/50 MR unless specified. Target35% HP; no E/W; Granite Shield intact. Shojin4 stacks/Riftmaker full ramp only if equipped, earned on separate champion before hit; all states logged.

Record R alone; compare armor-based E separately and do not grant armor an R ratio.

Isolate the named ability/passive packet from item procs, rune damage and the rest of the combo. Record raw versus post-resistance damage, actual crit outcome, charge, rank and target state. Healing/shield/execute thresholds are separate metrics, not damage.

Use the stated benchmark, not free infinite stacks or allied buffs. The initial form fields are editable defaults (level18, target3000HP/100armor/50MR); adjust them and record every other requirement before measuring.
failureConditions: The candidate loses the intended packet gain after real mitigation, charge restrictions, proc behavior or buff eligibility is measured.

tradeoffs: Six completed items model a late-game boots swap. Reaching range and surviving preparation become harder; expensive specialized stats sacrifice ordinary pacing and utility.
Confidence: plausible. This is a finite-condition ceiling candidate, not a solver-certified global maximum or a recommended match build.
buyOrder: This is a late six-item ceiling loadout. Compare individual item swaps at fixed level, earned stacks and target conditions; the displayed order is not a lane shopping order.
Keep boots and role starters during the actual game. A damage-slot boot replacement requires a deliberate late benchmark and may make the ability impossible to land.
